g.text: You Proved a Single Agent Can Work.
Now Architect Multiple Agents to Work Together.
Building a single agent is straightforward. Designing coordinated, reliable multi-agent
systems under real-world conditions is hard.
WELL-ENGINEERED SYSTEMS ARE THE BRIDGE FROM PILOT TO PRODUCTION
Isolated prompts can't solve enterprise problems. Single-agent limitations,
context bottlenecks, and unpredictable handoffs block production scale.
Combine orchestration, MCP integration, context engineering, and
deterministic guardrails to deliver trusted outcomes at scale.
Widely accepted industry patterns and practices
Learn by building a functional multi-agent reference application in a
Start with a pre-built harness and focus on multi-agent architecture,
Business Use Case: Asset Outage Management
Track outages, affected assets, crew assignments, and restoration.
